prompt.text:
Implement `createEnvelopeSanitizer(allowedProducers)`. Configuration must be a non-empty array of distinct, non-empty strings; invalid configuration throws `TypeError`. The returned `sanitizeJobEnvelope(envelope)` accepts a plain object containing `producer`, `headers`, and `payload`. Reject malformed envelopes with `{ ok: false, error: "malformed" }`. Reject an unlisted producer with `{ ok: false, error: "producer_not_allowed" }`. Headers must be a plain object with string values. Normalize header names to lowercase, processing original names in lexicographic order; two names that normalize to the same value make the envelope malformed. Require non-empty `trace-id` and `client-version` headers, otherwise return `{ ok: false, error: "missing_metadata" }`. Remove `authorization` and `x-api-key`. Return `{ ok: true, value: { producer, headers, payload } }`, with normalized remaining headers inserted in lexicographic order. Do not mutate any input or configuration. The payload must retain its original reference. Export exactly `{ createEnvelopeSanitizer }`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
